interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the right side of the street.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Install street trees within a new buffer zone to provide vertical enclosure, which naturally slows traffic and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Roadway Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to the roadway to better define travel lanes and encourage more predictable vehicle positioning.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using a high-visibility continental pattern to improve driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to remove cracks and ensure a smooth, accessible path.
